Q: How to dump a table to console? A:

For Lua 5.5+, the most upvoted dump function doesn't work, so here is the fixed futureproof variant of it:

function dump(o)
   if type(o) == 'table' then
      local s = '{ '
      for k,v in pairs(o) do
         local key = k
         if type(k) ~= 'number' then key = '""'..k..'""' end
         s = s .. '['..key..'] = ' .. dump(v) .. ','
      end
      return s .. '} '
   else
      return tostring(o)
   end
end
